title: Answers to the engine's questions
description: The user's answers to engine-questions.schema.json, given to `prepare` or `run` with --answers. Each answer names the question's round; an answer to an older round is ignored, so the whole file can simply be rewritten and passed again.

pitch.description: Either approve the drawn pitch, or give the keypoints; the engine refits and asks again in the next round.

points.description: Keypoints by name (the names in the question's points). A point the user moved has yaw and pitch; one left where the fit drew it, fromFit; one they couldn't see, skipped.

share.description: Whether the user agreed to share this pitch map and these points to improve pitch detection (the app's switch, on by default). The engine records it; the app sends.

kits.description: The kit-group check. Groups are named by their component number in the question.

tapped.description: Per group (component number as a string), the crop ids the user tapped as being in the wrong group or not a player in kit. Scores the grouping; not used to regroup.

merge.description: Sets of groups that are the same kit.

split.description: A group that holds two kits: the engine regroups with more components and asks again (once; see splitAllowed).

keeperOrReferee.description: Groups that are keepers or the referee. Missing: the engine's own guess.

notKit.description: Groups that aren't a kit (spectators, subs in bibs, shadows).

share.description: Whether the user agreed to share the shown crops and these answers to improve team detection (on by default).

cameras.description: Which phone is on the left: the question's panorama that shows the pitch in one piece.
